[youtube src=”https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xViPI6EWsUg”]

Young Gipsys with there Families coming together and helping each other, Dowries and negotiations between the families and helped by the elders.

Very beautiful weddings, can include, many uplights, colors, Backdrops, cinderella carriage, Beautiful dresses for the women and children and Suit and Tie for the men, food at the start of the night, and formal sit down dinner later on in the night, men on one side women on the other.

Most Popular Gipsy in Bay Area Are the Romany, latin, Serbian & Greek, East European.
Also some Turkish, Russia, Slovakia, Balkan, Hungary, Romani, Slovak, Scotland & Ireland, Poland, Ruthenian, and Transylvanian, Spain and France.
